Interactive filtered masonry gallery with modal zoom viewer. Categories: All, Bridal & Makeup, Hair Studio, Facials & Spa, Nail Art, Salon Ambience. Rich high-res Indian beauty imagery.

Curated testimonials with Google 4.9-star rating badge, client photos, verified tag, quote cards for bridal, hair spa, and facial clients from Zundal & Chandkheda. Includes 'Read More Reviews on Google' & 'Leave a Review' links.

Interactive salon destination block: Address card (Zundal, Near Vaishnodevi Circle, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382421), Opening Hours (Tue-Sun 10:00 AM - 8:00 PM, Mondays by Appointment), Embedded Google Map interactive iframe placeholder, and 3 immediate action buttons: 'Get Directions (Google Maps)', 'Call Now', 'Chat on WhatsApp'.
High-impact luxury conversion banner 'Ready for Your Beauty Appointment?' with instant booking interactive modal and direct WhatsApp & Call buttons.
Interactive appointment form modal enabling visitors to select Service, Preferred Date, Time Slot, and Name, generating an instant pre-filled WhatsApp message ready to send in 1 click.

Editorial 4-column luxury footer with brand story, quick navigation links, popular beauty services list, contact info with local Zundal Ahmedabad SEO schema hints, and social links (Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp).
Floating bottom bar for mobile screens (<768px) with 3 primary direct touch triggers: 'Call Now' (tel:), 'WhatsApp' (direct chat), and 'Book Appointment' (launches WhatsApp booking modal).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow luxury quiet-elegance beauty aesthetics: ivory/cream canvas (#FDFBF7), rose gold/terracotta (#C58B7E), charcoal (#231F20) text.
Do NOT use default pure black or saturated flat blue/purple SaaS gradients. Use warm soft drop-shadows, delicate 1px border highlights, and refined typography.
Include all 15 services required by the client prompt with tailored descriptions, prices, durations, and direct WhatsApp links.
Ensure all interactive buttons, links, tabs, and modals have explicit data-testid attributes.
Provide a smooth booking modal experience that generates customized WhatsApp chat messages for seamless client conversion.
Always maintain accessibility with high contrast text against soft cream backgrounds.
